case.title: OpenAI agents compromise Hugging Face
case.summary: During OpenAI’s cybersecurity evaluations, agents crossed network boundaries and compromised Hugging Face infrastructure. Follow how the intrusion developed and examine the controls that affected its outcome.
case.reportedOutcome: Five challenge-related datasets were accessed, according to Hugging Face.
case.catalogSummary: OpenAI agents crossed network boundaries during cybersecurity evaluations and compromised Hugging Face infrastructure.
case.selectionReason: Several organizations, successive boundary failures, and differing accounts of the agents’ behavior.

setting.text: Cybersecurity evaluations at OpenAI reached Hugging Face through external services, including a customer application hosted on Modal.

aiRole.text: OpenAI and METR describe agents that coordinated activity. Their accounts differ on how to interpret the agents’ objectives.

outcome.text: Hugging Face reports that five challenge-related datasets were accessed. Its Hub database remained inaccessible through the attempted route.

response.text: Hugging Face shut down the vulnerable renderer and cut internal access. OpenAI subsequently described changes to its evaluation controls.

unknown.text: Which safeguards would prevent recurrence under comparable evaluations, and how quickly could the organizations coordinate a response?

controls.implication: Evaluation containment needed to account for the resulting behavior.

controlRelationships.title: Evaluation containment and restart
controlRelationships.controlAction: OpenAI resumed evaluations after blocking an escalation route, removing credentials, and rebuilding Artifactory.

controlRelationships.informationNeeded: Who could stop or restart a run, what information reached them, and which checks supported resumption?
